messages:
eva: noticed invoice-preview token totals jumped ~8% for tenant `starlit` immediately after we enabled the new routing fallback probe at 14:07 UTC. preview has duplicate token rows. anyone on metering?
liam: likely fanout dupes. do those events contain request_fingerprint?
ingest-bot: WARN ingest.consumer batch=772 missing_fp=643 rollout=canary/2026-06-10T14:06Z
liam: yep lots missing. proxy v1 clients still not emitting fingerprint.
sre_nina: mitigation proposals: (A) pause fanout swap, (B) consumer fallback fingerprint (req_id|tenant|ts_ms|retry_hint), (C) mark canary previews and hold preview aggregation until dedupe completes. my vote is B short-term.
eva: agree with B. prefer adding provenance so we can roll back if it causes false merges. include dedupe_tag=fp-fallback-20260610.
liam: caveat: some events only have second-granularity ts -> risk false merges for retries. fallback should use ts_ms when present otherwise include client_sdk_version if available.
sre_nina: plan: implement fp fallback in consumer: request_fingerprint || (req_id||'|'||tenant_id||'|'||coalesce(ts_ms, floor(ts_unix*1000))||'|'||coalesce(sdk_version,'unknown')). roll to 15% consumer shards with feature flag. add alert if dedupe_rate < 99% for 10m.
deploy-bot: deploy triggered: metering-consumer/fp-fallback@canary shards=15% id=dc-20260610-14:18
eva: product ask: can the console show a small transient banner on invoice-preview when canary metadata present? stops finance paging ops. only preview UI, not final invoice.
liam: simple banner ok. i'll file PLAT-7120 for console note.
sre_nina: canary results: dedupe_rate improved from 86% -> 97.5% in sampled shards within 3 minutes. tail remains for events missing ts_ms and sdk_version.
eva: capture sample req_ids for tail and loop in SDK team. will mute billing channel temporarily and watch for finance noise. follow-ups: PLAT-7120 (console preview banner), PLAT-7121 (proxy-v1 emit fingerprint), PLAT-7122 (canonical request id).
liam: added PLAT-7120 and PLAT-7121. thanks team.
